doubts: Mixed RL and supervised paper; the RL Atari-57 result is taken as the main conclusion (Y3 57, X1 4 seeds). Q3/Q4: Rainbow uses DQN Zoo defaults without listing them or giving a version. Q7 yes only through the supervised test sets (CIFAR-10, ImageNet) and language benchmarks; Y8 no because the language evaluations are not presented as an out-of-distribution test. Q8/Y12: rliable-style IQM with 95% CIs (Agarwal et al. 2021), counted under the IQM rule. X4: equal two-learning-rate budget for every agent, but only in the Brax appendix; the Atari agents all use defaults. Y1: 'normalized score' / 'normalized return' never defined. Y5: Rainbow variants run in DQN Zoo, but the plasticity methods in Figure 5 (ReDo, Shrink & Perturb, ...) have no stated source. Q5: the checklist says the code is not released.
